chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The breath of a man is a step towards his death.
ai.seo_question: What does the breath of a man represent in relation to his death?
ai.summary: In this profound aphorism from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) equates the act of breathing with the progression toward death, highlighting the continuous, minute-by-minute erosion of life. This metaphor serves as a spiritual reminder for believers to maximize their worship and good deeds, viewing each breath not merely as biological function but as a step closer to the final accounting. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *zuhd* (asceticism) and the urgency of preparing for the Hereafter while time remains.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 74. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
The breath of a man is a step towards his death. [1]
